answer: At dawn each identity joins one lineage, capped at eight members, whose epoch reward is fixed at 1,200 POA no matter how many join: a willow bends but one trunk feeds all its branches, so a hundred fakes under one lineage split the same 1,200 POA and each fake's share collapses to 12 POA. Starting a new lineage costs a 400 POA genesis bond plus three established sponsors staking 50 POA each, slashed if the lineage is later proven fake. Like a sonnet, the form is fixed: if two lineages share one funding cluster they are merged and both bonds burn. Faking scales the cost, not the reward.
